d: New Zealand defeated India by 87 runs in the 4th T20I, with Glenn Phillips smashing 107 off 49 balls and Michael Bracewell scoring a quickfire 65 to help the Kiwis post a record 259/7. Jacob Duffy starred with the ball, taking 4/23 as India were restricted to 172/9. Despite the defeat, India maintain a 3-1 lead in the five-match series, while Arshdeep Singh became the first Indian bowler to reach 150 T20I wickets.
